title: The Kiosk Ate My Points. I Built A Folder.
script: Our neighborhood pizza chain made us redeem rewards only through a kiosk that glitched constantly, and support always blamed user error whenever it ate someone's points. Mine vanished the week I hit a free pizza. Instead of arguing at the counter, I started screenshotting every glitch, mine and four strangers' who hit the same error that same week. I built a shared folder, found the chain's own consumer complaints email buried in their privacy policy, and sent corporate a timeline with timestamps. Three weeks later the chain announced a loyalty audit, quietly restored six months of missing points to every account that had filed a ticket, and fired the vendor running the kiosks. I got my free pizza. It arrived a little cold, which felt about right. Forty-two strangers got theirs too, and none of them ever knew who started the folder.
